$comment: Advisories the Dependency audit job accepts, each with why and when to look again. Remove an entry as soon as a patched version is available. Anything high/critical NOT listed here still fails the job.

advisories.reason: Flagged in every published version (no patched release to upgrade to). Reached only through development tooling: nodemon -> chokidar (backend); tailwindcss -> chokidar/micromatch and eslint-config-next -> fast-glob -> micromatch (frontend). None of these ship in the production build; `npm audit --omit=dev` is clean at high.
